candidate_windows.window_text: We use the BART-Large model, whose encoder and decoder each has 12 layers for all experiments, making it the same number of transformer layers as the BERT-Large and RoBERTa-Large model. We did not use any other embeddings, and the BART model is fine-tuned during the optimization. We put more detailed experimental settings in the Supplementary Material. We report the span-level F1.

The detailed hyper-parameter used in different datasets are listed in Table 7. We use the slanted triangular learning rate warmup. All experiments are conducted in the Nvidia Ge-Force RTX-3090 Graphical Card with 24G graphical memory. Table 7: Hyper-parameters used for CoNLL2003, OntoNotes, ACE2004, ACE2005, Genia, CADEC, ShARE13, ShARE14.
HyperValue
Epoch30
Warmup step0.01
Learning rate[1e-5,2e-5,4e-5]
Batch size16
BARTLarge
α0.5
Beam size[1, 4]
